site.name: PAFOI
site.tagline: A place to share and grow idea seeds into living systems of action.

hero.heading: Grow ideas into living systems of action.
hero.description: Plant a Forest of Ideas (PAFOI) is a place to share, grow and connect idea seeds through people, conversations, collaborations, stories, projects and places. It is a space where questions, possibilities and early ideas can take root and develop into practical initiatives through shared inquiry and stewardship.

about.heading: A place for ideas to take root.
about.content:
Plant a Forest of Ideas (PAFOI) is a platform for sharing idea seeds and developing them into practical initiatives, stories, collaborations and places. It is a place to bring questions, possibilities and early ideas into conversation, learning, relationship and action.

Ideas become stronger through people, shared inquiry, experiments, stories, projects, local activity and stewardship. PAFOI provides a grounded space where thinking and doing can grow together.

items.title: Ideas
items.description: Questions, possibilities, stories, frameworks and early seeds that deserve attention, care and development. Every idea starts small — what matters is giving it the right conditions to grow.

items.title: People
items.description: Contributors, practitioners, neighbours, collaborators and communities gathered around ideas that matter. Strong ideas need people to carry them forward.

items.title: Action
items.description: Turning shared inquiry into experiments, projects, gatherings, stories, places and practical next steps. Ideas become real when they move from thought into practice.

placemake.heading: Let’s Placemake
placemake.content: Let’s Placemake is PAFOI’s outreach programme for bringing ideas into shared spaces, conversations and practical local action. It connects thinking with doing — helping ideas move from early possibility into real places, real conversations and real contributions.

items.title: Idea seed in development
items.description: A placeholder for an idea seed currently being explored. Details will be added as the idea develops through conversation and shared inquiry.

items.title: Conversation to be planted
items.description: A placeholder for a future conversation or gathering. This will emerge when the conditions, people and purpose are clear.

items.title: Project taking root
items.description: A placeholder for a project in its early stages. This space will hold initiatives that are moving from idea into action through experimentation and stewardship.

cta.heading: Join, collaborate or host.
cta.description: Bring an idea, start a conversation, collaborate, contribute, host a gathering or explore a local initiative. Whether you are just starting to think about something or you already have something to share, there is a place for you here.
